task: Research brawler/fighter mechanics for Concrete Dragon
resume_brief: Research gameplay mechanics from Final Fight, Streets of Rage, Street Fighter, Tekken: move systems, combo structures, animations, hit reactions, blocking/parry, throws, special meters. Produce a concrete incorporation plan for Concrete Dragon: which mechanics to adopt, how they map to the existing combat system, animation requirements. Write findings to ~/workspace/concrete-dragon-launch/research/fighter-mechanics.md. Verify against real sources. No invented facts.
